title: Storage-Based Strategic Manipulation of Constraint-Binding Patterns in Power Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.15755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies the strategic market participation of a monopolistic energy   storage aggregator (ESA) in a day-ahead electricity market. The ESA coordinates   geographically distributed storage units, submits a coordinated bid for its   portfolio, and may hold financial transmission rights (FTRs). The system   operator clears the market through a network-constrained, multi-period economic   dispatch, determining generation and load schedules, nodal prices,   energy-market payments, and FTR payoffs. We formulate the ESA--system-operator   interaction as a Stackelberg game and characterize its equilibrium through a   constraint-binding-pattern decomposition of the market-clearing problem.   Beyond enabling equilibrium computation, the framework reveals how the ESA can   increase its profit by strategically inducing or avoiding particular   constraint-binding patterns. translated_title: 电力网络中基于储能的约束绑定模式策略性操控
translated_abstract: 本文研究了垄断性能源储能聚合商（ESA）在日前电力市场中的策略性市场参与行为。ESA协调地理位置分散的储能单元，为其储能组合提交协调竞价，并可能持有金融输电权（FTR）。系统运营商通过网络约束的多周期经济调度来出清市场，确定发电和负荷计划、节点电价、能量市场支付以及FTR收益。我们将ESA与系统运营商的交互建模为Stackelberg博弈，并通过对市场出清问题的约束绑定模式分解来刻画其均衡。除了支持均衡计算之外，该框架还揭示了ESA如何通过策略性地诱导或避免特定的约束绑定模式来增加其利润。研究还建立了一个新颖的福利结果：尽管策略性储能（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文通过约束绑定模式分解刻画了垄断性储能聚合商与系统运营商之间Stackelberg博弈的均衡，揭示了储能聚合商可策略性地诱导或规避特定线路约束绑定模式来操纵节点电价并提升自身利润。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes the equilibrium of a Stackelberg game between a monopolistic energy storage aggregator and the system operator through a constraint-binding-pattern decomposition of the market-clearing problem, revealing how the aggregator can strategically induce or avoid particular binding constraints to manipulate nodal prices and increase its profit.
